buildProposal.decision: Implement the authorized issue 333 Account-first intelligence workspace and connected Workshop successor in shared C3.
buildProposal.scope: Shared source-bound Account readout, priorities, people and operating context, technology, discoveries, hypotheses and gaps; separate unreviewed inspection of four already-acquired public sources and nine exact excerpts; editorial responsive presentation and Account return position; tests and design guide. Preserve historical source and raw-response bytes, account scope/date distinctions and downstream recorded/manual-only behavior. No runtime acquisition or new product generation, provider or spend-route activation, durable product writes, assignment, sharing, content ratification, outreach, deployment, migration or protection changes. Prior bounded operator research is historical and separately authorized, not an effect enabled by this code. Require independent technical review, exact-head hosted checks and ordinary checked merge; no human approval or customer acceptance is inferred.
